strategy: Follow the goal direction when unblocked; otherwise use a safe fallback in FORWARD, LEFT, RIGHT order.

decisions.condition: Choose FORWARD when it is the unblocked goal direction, or when the goal is blocked and forward is unblocked.
Choose LEFT when it is the unblocked goal direction, or when the goal is blocked, forward is blocked, and left is unblocked.
Choose RIGHT when it is the unblocked goal direction, or when the goal is blocked, forward and left are blocked, and right is unblocked.
Choose STOP only when all three movement directions are blocked.

stop_condition: Stop when all three movement directions are blocked.
